BiblicalUsage: To finish is what God does to kingdoms and men do to temples. MENE: God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it. Sheshbazzar laid the foundation of the house of God, and since that time it has been in building, and yet it is not finished. Ezra is told to deliver the vessels for the service of the house of God before Him in Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe finishing belongs to God. He finishes kingdoms and He finishes temples, and I hold that the work He starts in His people He will finish too.
